verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents an OpenAI-compatible `/chat/completions` endpoint reachable through a single URL. It also says you switch providers by changing only the `model` and `apiKey` parameters, which matches the drop-in story. missing for 10: an explicit documented example of repointing an existing OpenAI SDK by swapping only the base URL, independent or hands-on corroboration of drop-in compatibility.

support.subject: As a developer, I can point existing OpenAI-compatible code at the gateway by changing only the base URL and key

citations.quote: Cloudflare's AI Gateway offers an OpenAI-compatible `/chat/completions` endpoint, enabling integration with multiple AI providers using a single URL.
Switch providers by changing the \`model\` and \`apiKey\` parameters.
This feature simplifies the integration process, allowing for seamless switching between different models without significant code modifications.
